terminal.renderer: terminal-only capsule-local xterm.js Runtime PTY terminal
terminal.input: keyboard, paste, mouse, and resize events -> Runtime-owned PTY stream
terminal.pty: Runtime-owned PTY; xterm sends input bytes and renders PTY output without direct host process authority
terminal.xterm: capsule-local @xterm/xterm renderer autostarted over the Runtime-owned start/events/input/resize/close stream contract
terminal.entrypoint: the same home-cli binary runs inside the Runtime PTY and through `elastos home` over local Home state

commands.name: home
commands.description: Show the signed Home summary, active shell, runtime, inbox, app, and capsule counts.

commands.name: apps
commands.description: List visible launch targets from the Runtime-owned Home snapshot.

commands.name: invoke
commands.description: In Home CLI line mode, resolve a declared runtime-policy affordance and write a structured Home intent. User/high-risk methods stay blocked.

commands.name: inbox
commands.description: Show Inbox notifications and approval hints surfaced through Runtime facts.

commands.name: people
commands.description: Show contacts, People discovery, visible homes, requests, and available People actions from Runtime facts.

commands.name: mywebsite
commands.description: Show MyWebSite status, stage a local directory, start a local preview, publish a temporary public URL, or explicitly open the preview in a browser.

commands.name: wallet
commands.description: Show wallet capsules and wallet approval notifications from Runtime facts.

commands.name: exits
commands.description: List local and remote Browser Exit offers from the Services projection.

commands.name: system
commands.description: Show System settings and run explicit settings actions such as switching back to home-gui through the Runtime-owned active-shell state.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Show diagnostics that are hidden from the default Home CLI product surface. Debug rows are descriptors, not grants.

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Ask Home to refresh the Runtime-owned snapshot.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show the Home CLI command contract.

commands.name: exit
commands.description: Home CLI line/TUI mode writes a quit intent. In browser root mode, q or Esc returns to home-gui when the Runtime terminal exits.

controls.description: sent as raw terminal input to the Runtime-owned PTY
select the previous or next visible item
switch to the next section; Shift+Tab switches back
exit Home CLI; in browser root mode this returns to home-gui
Inbox only: mark read or dismiss
sent as terminal input through the same launch-token-gated input route
wheel selects items; tab-row clicks switch sections
reported to Runtime through the terminal resize route
